apps.name: AppSweep
apps.tagline: Uninstall apps and every file they leave behind.
apps.description: Pick any app in /Applications and AppSweep finds its caches, preferences, containers and support files across your Mac. You choose what to remove.

apps.name: Crest
apps.tagline: 29 tools that drop out of your MacBook's notch.
apps.description: A black panel slides out of the notch (or a virtual notch on external displays) with media controls, a clipboard, timers, system stats and more, one hover away.

apps.name: NotchDock
apps.tagline: Hidden docks and widgets that live in the notch.
apps.description: Hover the notch or a screen edge to reveal quick-launch docks and a full widget library, then let them tuck away again.

apps.name: Glint
apps.tagline: A radial, type-to-switch app switcher.
apps.description: Apps fan out around your pointer. Type a few letters to fuzzy-match any running or installed app and release to switch. Works with any keyboard layout.

apps.name: Tuck
apps.tagline: A drag-and-drop shelf at the edge of your screen.
apps.description: Start dragging anything and a shelf slides in. Park files there, switch apps, Spaces or full-screen windows, then drag them out where they belong.

apps.name: Tapwise
apps.tagline: Double-tap your MacBook to trigger 50 actions.
apps.description: Tapwise reads the built-in accelerometer on Apple silicon MacBooks and turns a double or triple tap on the case into screenshots, media control, shortcuts and more.

apps.name: Wattline
apps.tagline: See what each app costs your battery, right now.
apps.description: A menu bar app that explains your battery in minutes of runtime per app, with charge limits, Low Power Mode control and a desktop widget.

apps.name: SiliconScope
apps.tagline: An Apple silicon performance observatory.
apps.description: Live P-core and E-core load, GPU, memory pressure, power and thermals in the menu bar, plus per-process CPU, energy and wakeups.

apps.name: Spyglass
apps.tagline: A file browser that sits alongside Finder.
apps.description: Browse, clean up and check your Mac's health, with Apple Intelligence, Shortcuts actions, routines and 69 on-device tools.

apps.name: FolderPilot
apps.tagline: Rules that rename, tag and file things for you.
apps.description: Watch folders and run workflows: when a PDF lands in Downloads, read its date, rename it, tag it and file it in the right folder.

apps.name: Padwise
apps.tagline: A fast, native source-code editor.
apps.description: Tabs, syntax highlighting, search across files and a classic editor feel, written from scratch in Swift and AppKit. No Electron, no web views.

apps.name: Juxta
apps.tagline: Compare and merge files, folders, tables and images.
apps.description: A native diff and merge tool with a custom canvas that draws only visible rows and scrolls every pane in lockstep.

apps.name: RedactIQ
apps.tagline: Private, on-device PDF redaction.
apps.description: Finds sensitive information, even in scanned pages, lets you review it, burns redactions in permanently and proves they worked with an audit report.

apps.name: Calendesk
apps.tagline: A beautiful calendar pinned to your desktop.
apps.description: Month grid, agenda, tear-off day page and week strip styles, as a borderless desktop widget. The companion to Tickdesk.

apps.name: Tickdesk
apps.tagline: Flip, LCD, minimal and analog desktop clocks.
apps.description: A borderless clock widget for your desktop with four styles, custom fonts and colors, and pin, float or lock options.

apps.name: Hearth
apps.tagline: A cozy, local-first personal dashboard.
apps.description: To-dos, journaling, habits, a focus timer and a shelf of what you're enjoying, all in one warm window. No account, no cloud.

apps.name: HobbyAtlas
apps.tagline: A project manager built for hobbies.
apps.description: Plan gardening, model building, electronics, woodworking and collections with projects, materials, steps and photos.

apps.name: Kalam
apps.tagline: A quiet daily journal.
apps.description: A calm writing space for one entry a day, with prompts, streaks and a timeline of everything you've written.

apps.name: DreamAtlas
apps.tagline: A private dream journal and pattern explorer.
apps.description: Record dreams, tag emotions and themes, and see what recurs over time. Locked with Touch ID, stored only on your Mac.

apps.name: Readscape
apps.tagline: Visual reading intelligence for your bookshelf.
apps.description: Track books and progress, keep a reading journal, connect related books into reading maps and see your reading stats.

apps.name: RecipeCanvas
apps.tagline: A studio for recipes and cooking experiments.
apps.description: Build personal recipes, record substitutions, compare versions of a dish and print recipe cards.

apps.name: Platewise
apps.tagline: Snap a dish, get the recipe, plan the week.
apps.description: A meal planner where Apple Intelligence identifies a photographed dish on-device and writes the full recipe, nutrition and allergy notes.
